think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s normal domain and meaning across its numeric range. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value(s) trigger a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable logging/feature, auto-tune, sentinel behavior) rather than just “more/less” of the same behavior. 3) If such sentinel value(s) exist, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
